series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction, moderate seasonality, and high noise with unpredictable patterns. Due to high spectral entropy and unstable rankings, a robust baseline approach (e.g., median) is recommended to avoid overfitting to noisy or conflicting model predictions.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true → high spectral entropy (0.8385) indicates near-white-noise; robust_median is preferred over mean to avoid outlier sensitivity
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.0994) → unstable rankings suggest soft combiners with shrinkage (0.35) are more robust than hard selection
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure

excluded_highlights.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p2_sh0.0: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid contains 'stl_hierarchical_stacking' due to high noise and unstable rankings
